intended_use.primary_intended_use: Decision-support exploratory risk stratification on tabular patient health markers.
intended_use.primary_users: Clinical ML researchers, healthcare educators, students.
out_of_scope_use_cases: Automated emergency triage without physician review

training_data.source: Cardiovascular Disease Tabular Cohort (70,000 patient records)

ethical_considerations.fairness_demographics: Model relies on physical biomarkers (BP, BMI, Age, Lipids). Performance should be routinely calibrated across diverse demographic sub-populations.
ethical_considerations.disclaimer: Academic ML proof-of-concept. All outputs are risk probabilities, not diagnostic determinations.
